title: Animated Toast
subtitle: Brief messages that stack in the corner and can be swiped away.

descriptions.variant: Kind of message. Loading → success shows a spinner, then succeeds after a moment.
descriptions.showDescription: Adds a second line of detail under the title.
descriptions.collapsibleDescription: Long descriptions fold to one line with a toggle to expand. Needs Description on.
descriptions.showAction: Adds an Undo button to the toast.
descriptions.timeout: How long a toast stays before closing itself, in seconds. 0 keeps it until dismissed.
descriptions.elastic: Toasts spring in with a slight overshoot.
descriptions.originFromTrigger: Toasts grow out of the button that opened them.
descriptions.fadeContent: The toast's text fades in just after the toast arrives.
descriptions.exitAnimation: How a toast leaves when it closes.
descriptions.tiltOnSwipe: Toasts tilt in the direction you swipe them away.
descriptions.morphIcon: The loading spinner morphs into a tick on success. Only for the Loading → success variant, or after Undo with Show action on.
descriptions.showTimerBar: A bar shrinks to show the time left. Not used with Stays for 0; with Loading → success it appears after the success.
descriptions.showAccentEdge: A coloured line on the edge for success, info, warning and error toasts. Not used by Default.
descriptions.position: Where on the screen toasts stack.

themeDescription: Colour palette, toasts included. Any theme but Default also tints the timer bar.
